history.notes: Wed 2026-07-01 opener into July-4th weekend; reported 3-day (Fri-Sun) $36.4M, 5-day $61.4M; recorded Thu-Sun to match model span. July-4th Sat crater ($9.47M, -43%) -> excluded from day-weight fit. Live pre-revert model over-read ~$62M (Thursday anchor over-scale); reverted commit 89ed09b.

2,725-theatre Friday opener; AMC under-programmed opening day (2.4 showings/cinema Fri, tripled to 6.1 Sat) so the AMC panel read a supply-constrained signal; cross-chain share made it worse (occupancy high BECAUSE showings were scarce). Model -61%, worst miss on record. Sat held +1% on July 4 (adult audience) while Minions crashed -43%.
